lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for single-test categories: adoption redesigns, finish changes (hint, layout, new screen, redesign), home new_flow, sign-in notifications, and sign-in reordering.
Home wait_info changes are helpful, supported by 2 winning tests out of 3.
Choose_path redesigns and choose_path copy updates showed no positive effect across 2 tests each, ranging from neutral to worse.
Adoption hints (3 tests), home redesigns (2 tests), sign-in copy updates (2 tests), and sign-in incentives (2 tests) showed no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently too low for winning changes and too high for changes that showed no clear effect or performed worse.

candidates.title: Account Sign In Post Adoption Reorder
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step after adoption certificate so users pick and create their pet companion before creating or syncing an account.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users early in the funnel; letting users build emotional investment in their pet first leverages completion drive.

candidates.title: Pet Generation Stage Tracker Checklist
candidates.change: Display a dynamic checklist of pet asset preparation phases (3D Mesh, Textures, Animation Rig) on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home step waiting time is long (median 201s, mean 2336s). Lessons show home wait_info changes effectively sustain user engagement.

waiting.headline: Crafting Your Desktop Companion
waiting.body: Your pet model, animation rig, and desktop overlays are rendering.

guard.reason: Valid addition of dynamic asset checklist to waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Strong confidence from previous home wait_info wins (+2.8%); directly addresses long home wait time.

candidates.title: Desktop Interaction Overlay Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated screen before final launch showcasing desktop pet shortcuts, drag actions, and summon hotkeys.
candidates.why: Support logs show multiple user confusion complaints about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.

new_interaction_guide.headline: Desktop Pet Controls
new_interaction_guide.body: Drag to move your pet around, right-click for interactions, or press Alt+P to summon.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: Adoption Stage Pet Selection View
candidates.change: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a split layout separating trait details from the interactive pet model preview.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate (69.8%) and a long median duration (89s). Evidence is still thin for adoption redesigns.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Companion
pick_friend.body: Select an archetype and customize traits for your desktop assistant.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Account Reset Protection Warning Notice
candidates.change: Display a sign-in status alert banner confirming account sync safety to prevent pet reset issues upon re-login.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets cited missing or reset pets after signing in again. Evidence is thin for sign-in notifications.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Preserve Your Pet
sign_in.body: Syncing saves your pet's state, custom outfits, and memory securely.

guard.reason: Valid sign-in protection status badge added.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail and funnel evidence, but low confidence due to historical sign-in notification test (-0.7%).

candidates.title: Desktop Environment Readiness Assessment Flow
candidates.change: Insert a desktop compatibility step during the render phase to check display resolution and window overlay permissions.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pets failing to appear on the desktop or app startup stalls. Evidence is thin for home new_flow.

new_desktop_check.headline: Checking Desktop Overlay Permissions
new_desktop_check.body: Ensuring screen overlay compatibility so your pet displays properly on your workspace.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: Home Welcome Companion Spotlight Layout
candidates.change: Rebuild the home_intro screen into a stage layout placing the pet in focus alongside quick action shortcuts.
candidates.why: Finish conversion drops 17.6% with mean time 5815s. Support emails show post-onboarding interaction confusion.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion!
home_intro.body: Your companion is live on your desktop. Right-click your pet anytime to configure preferences.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a preview cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Custom Pet Render Error Recovery Checklist
candidates.change: Provide photo quality confirmation and image rendering guidelines on the upload_photos screen.
candidates.why: Support received 3 bug reports regarding custom pet generation failures and rendering visual artifacts.

upload_photos.hint: Use bright, single-subject photos to avoid pet generation glitches.

guard.reason: Valid photo clarity hint and checklist added to upload_photos screen.

candidates.score_note: Targets the highest drop-off step (adoption loses 30.2%) with support ticket backing; moderate confidence.

candidates.title: Companion Archetype Selection Perk Badge
candidates.change: Add perk badges highlighting unique companion behaviors for each selection path.
candidates.why: Choose_path mean completion time is 514s (median 8s), indicating a subset of users hesitate when choosing a path.

guard.reason: Promotes false scarcity by claiming a path unlocks an exclusive companion personality.

candidates.title: Desktop Docking and Hide Controls Hint
candidates.change: Show a visible quick hint on home_intro explaining how to hide or dock the pet in the system tray.
candidates.why: Support complaints indicate users struggle to find controls for hiding or minimizing the pet after completing setup.

home_intro.hint: Press Alt+P to show/hide your pet or right-click the system tray icon to pause companion activity.

guard.reason: Valid desktop docking hint added to home_intro.

candidates.score_note: Low confidence due to prior finish hint test (-2.9%) and low impact potential on the finish step.
